description: This Java source file defines a service class 'RandomNumberProviderService' that provides complication data for an Android Wearable watch face, generating and updating random number complications.

classes.name: RandomNumberProviderService
classes.description: A service class that provides random number data for watch face complications, handling activation, updates, and deactivation events.

methods.name: onComplicationActivated
methods.description: Handles the event when a complication is activated; performs any one-time setup.

methods.name: onComplicationUpdate
methods.description: Generates a random number and updates the complication data based on the data type.

methods.name: onComplicationDeactivated
methods.description: Handles the event when a complication is deactivated.
